# Ambesh Tiwari

> Ambesh Tiwari is a Business Operating Systems consultant, AI trainer, author and founder of BDA Technologies. He helps founder-led businesses reduce founder dependency through clear SOPs, workflows, reporting systems and practical AI processes. Consulting and training are led by Ambesh personally; technical implementation is delivered by the team at BDA Technologies.

Ambesh Tiwari is based in Delhi, India. He works with founder-led businesses across India, the UAE and Africa. He personally leads the business diagnostic, leadership discussions, process and workflow design, SOP architecture, reporting and accountability structure, AI adoption strategy, team training and major reviews. The BDA Technologies team implements the dashboards, workflows, automations, integrations and AI tools when required. He has trained 5,000+ professionals across 50+ organisations in 11 industries, and is the author of Accelerate with AI and host of the Inspire with Ambesh podcast.
